entities.name: Emergency number list
entities.description: An information element that contains a list of emergency numbers valid within the same country as the PLMN from which it is received.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may send the emergency number list information element.

entities.name: PLMN
entities.description: Public Land Mobile Network from which the emergency number list is received.

relations.description: The network may send the emergency number list information element.
The emergency number list contents are valid within the same country as the PLMN from which it is received.
